jobs.title: Data Engineer, Data : Science Engineering, AWS Marketing, Data : Science Engineering, AWS Marketing,  TAA-Data: Science & Engineering
jobs.description: Would you like to support increasing customer base and the revenue for AWS, a market-leading cloud offering? Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing awareness and adoption of the AWS platform by analyzing customer's behavior on and outside AWS websites? Do you want to empower our AWS Marketing organization make data-driven decisions that further establish AWS as leader in the cloud computing world? Key job responsibilities As a Data Engineer at AWS, you will be working in a large, extremely complex and dynamic data warehousing environment. We are looking for someone with the uncanny ability to integrate multiple heterogeneous data sources with AWS Marketing Data Warehouse - Jarvis and build efficient, flexible, and scalable data warehouse and reporting solutions. You should be enthusiastic about learning new technologies and be able to implement solutions using these technologies to enable upgrades of the existing platform. You should have excellent business and communication skills and be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, then build the data sets that answer those questions. You should be expert at designing, implementing, and operating stable, scalable, low cost solutions to flow data from production systems into the data warehouse and into end-user facing reporting applications. Above all you should be passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions and drive growth. At AWS, you have control over every layer you build. Instead of owning a small slice of an existing service, you will own a core segment of a growing marketing platform serving 1000s of internal customers and millions of external customers. You will build on multiple AWS services and have opportunities to engage directly with those teams to improve our core offerings. At AWS, we work with our customers on a daily basis to prove out our ideas, gather feedback, and improve the platform. A day in the life A day in the life Design, implement, and support a platform providing ad-hoc access to large datasets Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL Build robust and scalable data integration (ETL) pipelines using SQL, Python and AWS services such as Data Pipelines, Glue Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and SQL/Redshift Interface with business customers, gathering requirements and delivering complete reporting solutions Build and deliver high quality datasets to support business analyst and customer reporting needs Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self-service support for customers About the team Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS) AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services. Mission Statement The AWS Marketing Data: AI Science, Analytics and Engineering (D:SE) team owns analytics, reporting and self-service tooling, data representation, machine learning models, measurement, valuation and economics products for AWS Marketing. We are the central data and science organization, and we work with different teams in AWS Marketing to drive better measurement, increase experimentation velocity, improve data access and analytical self-service, deploy and test ML-powered targeting models, drive higher economic value, and empower strategic decisions with business deep dives. We enable other analytics, BI, and science teams across AWS Marketing through mechanisms, partnerships and scalable tools. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS - Amazon EKS
jobs.description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) is a fully managed Kubernetes service that enables customers to run Kubernetes seamlessly in both AWS Cloud and on-premises data centers. The EKS Management Plane team is responsible for the EKS API and the services behind it that take a customer's intent and turn it into a running, upgradeable, recoverable Kubernetes cluster, so customers can innovate with containers without becoming experts in the underlying technologies. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to work on cluster lifecycle, availability, and insights: the state management and orchestration behind every cluster operation, the health detection that tells customers what is wrong before it impacts them, capabilities like Kubernetes version rollback that make a failed upgrade recoverable instead of terminal, and control plane evacuation that makes an Availability Zone impairment a non-event. In this role, you will: - Build and improve state machines and orchestration workflows that drive cluster create, update, and upgrade operations - Develop health-detection systems that surface actionable insights to customers before issues become outages - Contribute to resilience capabilities (rollback, failover, self-healing) from design through production - Collaborate with experienced engineers across EKS to solve problems that span multiple services and teams You will engineer distributed systems at scale and solve hard problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with deep expertise. We evaluate trade-offs in the open and give every engineer ownership of critical customer-facing systems. You will grow through end-to-end feature ownership and expanding your influence across the team. This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue twice. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Ads Console Frameworks
jobs.description: We're building the platform that powers the Amazon Ads Console — the framework layer that drives development velocity, latency, and availability improvements for tens of product teams building advertising experiences. As the console transitions toward agentic, AI-driven workflows, we need a Senior SDE to lead the technical evolution of our platform and the new systems that will underpin this shift. The Ads Console Frameworks team owns Pantheon (the app framework powering the console's architecture), Argus (an agentic quality evaluation platform that autonomously walks advertiser workflows to detect regressions), Compass (a self-serve product analytics platform for the console), and the shared services and components that every Ads Console page depends on. Our systems serve as the foundation dozens of teams build on. This is not a heads-down coding role. You'll drive architectural decisions with broad ambiguity — designing how the console's frameworkS evolve to support agentic development patterns, defining how product analytics should work across 141 pages, and shaping platform contracts that other teams adopt. You'll need strong product instincts to understand advertiser workflows and form a point of view on where framework-level solutions unlock the most leverage, and either bring knowledge of the advertising business or the curiosity to develop it quickly. The role spans technically complex domains — from front-end framework architecture and module systems, through platform services targeting 99.99% availability under peak load, to AI agent orchestration, evaluation systems, and governed data pipelines. You'll also be expected to embrace and advance AI-native development practices, using AI tools and agentic coding techniques to accelerate how the team builds software. This is a horizontal team role: you set technical direction that other teams build on, define API contracts and integration patterns across organizational boundaries, and maintain platform quality as adoption scales rapidly. The right candidate has designed and built platform systems at scale, can operate independently in highly ambiguous problem spaces, has recent hands-on experience with AI-powered or agent-oriented systems, and brings product thinking to every technical decision. Key job responsibilities - Lead technical architecture and hands-on delivery across the full AI application stack — UI, services, agent infrastructure, orchestration, and evaluation — for the Ads Agent experience and integration framework used by dozens of partner teams. - Bring product thinking to every technical decision: develop deep understanding of advertiser workflows so architecture choices reflect how advertisers actually use the product. - Set architectural direction on a horizontal platform team: define integration patterns and API contracts that dozens of teams build on, lead design reviews, and maintain quality as adoption scales. - Establish and exemplify best practices for building AI applications (evaluation methodologies, quality guardrails, prompt engineering, orchestration patterns) and for AI-native development (using AI tools and agentic coding to accelerate the team's delivery). - Drive operational excellence and mentor engineers across the team. A day in the life You start the day reviewing agent quality metrics and system health across the stack. Mid-morning you're leading a design review for a new framework capability — asking sharp questions that blend technical depth with product thinking about advertiser workflows. After lunch you're writing high-leverage code: the interface for a new extension point that partner teams will build on. Later you join a cross-team architecture discussion on whether a new capability should be a skill or a separate agent, driving alignment by making tradeoffs concrete. You close the day refactoring a service that grew complex during prototyping — because on a horizontal team, accumulated complexity compounds with every partner. About the team We are a team of ~50 engineers building the experience layer for the Amazon Ads Agent and Console. We own the chat interface, advertiser-facing communications, and the frameworks that enable dozens of partner teams to integrate agent capabilities across the Ads Console. This is a horizontal team — our APIs, patterns, and quality bar ripple across the organization. We're at an inflection point on two fronts: the product we build is an AI agent, and our development workflow is shifting to AI-native practices using agentic coding. Both are core to how we operate. We value technical depth, product-minded engineering, fast iteration, and building over theorizing. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.
